description:
A new client, Greenfield Insurance, needs a dedicated inbound support line configured in Vicidial. You must create both an Inbound Group (In-Group) and a DID entry, then link the DID to route calls into the In-Group.

The Vicidial admin panel is open in Firefox at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (credentials: user 6666, password andromeda).

**Step 1: Create the In-Group**
Navigate to the Inbound Groups section and create a new In-Group with these settings:
- Group ID: GREENFIELD_SUP
- Group Name: Greenfield Insurance Support
- Group Color: #009900
- Active: Y
- Next Agent Call: longest_wait_all
- Queue Priority: 99
- Fronter Display: Y

Save the In-Group.

**Step 2: Create the DID**
Navigate to the DIDs section and create a new DID entry with these settings:
- DID Extension/Pattern: 8005559247
- DID Description: Greenfield Main Support
- DID Route: IN_GROUP
- In-Group ID (route target): GREENFIELD_SUP
- DID Active: Y

Save the DID.

Both the In-Group and the DID must be fully saved in the system with the DID routing calls to the In-Group.
